rachel_marketing: Heads-up — HelixEdge agreed to a short case study. Need: 20-30m interview, signed asset release, final quote approval, logo + product screenshot. They prefer Tue/Wed mornings PT. Also ask for a one-line benchmark blurb (cost + latency).

 tom_prod: I can run the recording and do a light edit. Tue 10am PT works for me. I'll share a 1-pager prep checklist (mic, background, key points).

 ana_cs: Early numbers from their eng lead: "Redwood reduced inference costs by 48% and p99 latency from 480ms to 160ms in production." I'll confirm in writing today and CC their comms.

 victor_legal: Upload our standard release and request e-signature. We need explicit written approval of the quote before we publish. Link the release and CC me on the send.

 emily_sales: For promotion, route webinar signups to sd-helixedge queue and add me for escalation (emily_sales). If a registrant selects enterprise interest, forward to enterprise-sales@redwood and mark as high-priority. Also add an optional 15-min meeting slot post-webinar.

 scheduler-bot: Event created: "HelixEdge Case Study Recording" — Tue Jul 8 2025 17:00:00 UTC (10:00 PT) — invites sent to rachel_marketing, tom_prod, ana_cs, victor_legal, emily_sales.

 ana_cs: Confirmed via email and CC'd comms: "Confirmed: 48% cost reduction and p99 160ms are accurate for our production baseline after the rollout."

 rachel_marketing: Awesome. I'll send the release link to their comms lead and request logo + screenshot. Priors: keep landing copy tight — 1-line impact + two bullets (cost, latency). Draft landing + social copy ETA EOD tomorrow. Using this thread for approvals. :sparkles:
